posts.title: Preserving Hồ Ngọc Đức's Vietnamese Dictionary Dataset

posts.title: Are your models calibrated?
posts.description: A calibration curve (sometimes called a “reliability diagram”) tells you whether your model’s predicted probabilities accurately reflect the real chance of your model being right.
